SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON WO.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.ORDER_ID, P1.PROD_STATUS FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) P ON WO.ORDER_ID = P.ORDER_ID

I.ITEM_ID, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_UNIT,
L.LINE_CODE, L.LINE_NAME, L.LINE_STATUS,
E.EMPNO, E.ENAME, E.DEPT, E.JOB, E.ROLE,
NVL(P.PROD_STATUS, '대기') AS PROD_STATUS
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON WO.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.ORDER_ID, P1.PROD_STATUS FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) P ON WO.ORDER_ID = P.ORDER_ID

SELECT PLAN.PROD_PLAN_ID, PLAN.PROD_PLAN_QTY, PLAN.ORDERED_QTY, PLAN.REMAIN_QTY, TO_CHAR(PLAN.PROD_PLAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_PLAN_DATE, TO_CHAR(PLAN.DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DUE_DATE, PLAN.DOC_NO, PLAN.ITEM_ID, PLAN.ITEM_CODE, PLAN.ITEM_NAME, PLAN.ITEM_TYPE, PLAN.ITEM_UNIT FROM ( SELECT PP.PROD_PLAN_ID, PP.PROD_PLAN_QTY, NVL(WO_SUM.ORDERED_QTY, 0) AS ORDERED_QTY, PP.PROD_PLAN_QTY - NVL(WO_SUM.ORDERED_QTY, 0) AS REMAIN_QTY, PP.PROD_PLAN_DATE, PP.DUE_DATE, PP.DOC_NO,
I.ITEM_ID, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_UNIT

JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROD_PLAN_ID, SUM(NVL(ORDER_QTY, 0)) AS ORDERED_QTY FROM WORK_ORDER GROUP BY PROD_PLAN_ID ) WO_SUM ON PP.PROD_PLAN_ID = WO_SUM.PROD_PLAN_ID ) PLAN WHERE PLAN.REMAIN_QTY > 0
AND TRUNC(PLAN.PROD_PLAN_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
ORDER BY PLAN.PROD_PLAN_DATE DESC, PLAN.PROD_PLAN_ID DESC

PP.DOC_NO AS PROD_PLAN_DOC_NO, PP.PROD_PLAN_QTY, TO_CHAR(PP.PROD_PLAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_PLAN_DATE, TO_CHAR(PP.DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DUE_DATE,

mapper.select:
SELECT B.BOM_ID, B.BOM_CODE, B.VERSION AS BOM_VERSION, B.USE_YN AS BOM_USE_YN,
BD.BOM_DETAIL_ID, BD.QTY AS BOM_QTY, CASE WHEN MI.ITEM_UNIT IN ('EA', '개', 'BOX') THEN CEIL(NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0)) ELSE NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0) END AS REQUIRED_QTY,
MI.ITEM_ID AS MATERIAL_ITEM_ID, MI.ITEM_CODE AS MATERIAL_ITEM_CODE, MI.ITEM_NAME AS MATERIAL_ITEM_NAME, MI.ITEM_TYPE AS MATERIAL_ITEM_TYPE, MI.ITEM_UNIT AS MATERIAL_ITEM_UNIT,
INOUT.INOUT_ID, INOUT.INOUT_TYPE, INOUT.MATERIAL_LOT, INOUT.INOUT_QTY, TO_CHAR(INOUT.INOUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INOUT_DATE, INOUT.STATUS AS INOUT_STATUS, INOUT.USE_YN, INOUT.REMARK AS INOUT_REMARK,
NVL(INV.AVAILABLE_QTY, 0) AS AVAILABLE_QTY,
CASE WHEN NVL(INV.AVAILABLE_QTY, 0) < CASE WHEN MI.ITEM_UNIT IN ('EA', '개', 'BOX') THEN CEIL(NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0)) ELSE NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0) END THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SHORTAGE_YN,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY BD.BOM_DETAIL_ID) AS ROW_NO
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN BOM B ON PP.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND NVL(B.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
JOIN BOM_DETAIL BD ON B.BOM_ID = BD.BOM_ID
JOIN ITEM MI ON BD.ITEM_ID = MI.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, SUM(NVL(INVENTORY_STOCK, 0)) AS AVAILABLE_QTY FROM INVENTORY WHERE STOCK_LOCATION NOT LIKE 'WH-HOLD%' AND STOCK_LOCATION NOT LIKE 'WH-DIS%' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) INV ON MI.ITEM_ID = INV.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN MATERIAL_INOUT INOUT ON INOUT.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND INOUT.ITEM_ID = MI.ITEM_ID AND INOUT.INOUT_TYPE = 'MO-PROD' AND NVL(INOUT.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
WHERE WO.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
ORDER BY BD.BOM_DETAIL_ID ASC

SELECT B.BOM_ID, B.BOM_CODE, B.VERSION AS BOM_VERSION,
BD.BOM_DETAIL_ID, BD.QTY AS BOM_QTY, CASE WHEN MI.ITEM_UNIT IN ('EA', '개', 'BOX') THEN CEIL(NVL(#{orderQty}, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0)) ELSE NVL(#{orderQty}, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0) END AS REQUIRED_QTY,
MI.ITEM_ID AS MATERIAL_ITEM_ID, MI.ITEM_CODE AS MATERIAL_ITEM_CODE, MI.ITEM_NAME AS MATERIAL_ITEM_NAME, MI.ITEM_TYPE AS MATERIAL_ITEM_TYPE, MI.ITEM_UNIT AS MATERIAL_ITEM_UNIT,
NVL(INV.AVAILABLE_QTY, 0) AS AVAILABLE_QTY,
CASE WHEN NVL(INV.AVAILABLE_QTY, 0) < CASE WHEN MI.ITEM_UNIT IN ('EA', '개', 'BOX') THEN CEIL(NVL(#{orderQty}, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0)) ELSE NVL(#{orderQty}, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0) END THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SHORTAGE_YN
FROM PRODUCTION_PLAN PP
JOIN BOM B ON PP.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND NVL(B.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
JOIN BOM_DETAIL BD ON B.BOM_ID = BD.BOM_ID
JOIN ITEM MI ON BD.ITEM_ID = MI.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, SUM(NVL(INVENTORY_STOCK, 0)) AS AVAILABLE_QTY FROM INVENTORY WHERE STOCK_LOCATION NOT LIKE 'WH-HOLD%' AND STOCK_LOCATION NOT LIKE 'WH-DIS%' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) INV ON MI.ITEM_ID = INV.ITEM_ID
WHERE PP.PROD_PLAN_ID = #{prodPlanId}
ORDER BY BD.BOM_DETAIL_ID ASC

( SELECT MIN(MI.MATERIAL_LOT) FROM MATERIAL_INOUT MI WHERE MI.ITEM_ID = #{materialItemId} AND MI.INOUT_TYPE = 'MI' AND MI.MATERIAL_LOT IS NOT NULL ),

'Y',
'완료',

CASE WHEN #{prodStatus} = '보류' THEN '보류' WHEN BEFORE_TOTAL_QTY + NVL(#{prodQty}, 0) + NVL(#{lossQty}, 0) >= TARGET_ORDER_QTY THEN '완료' ELSE '진행중' END,

MAX(PROD_STATUS) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY PROD_ID) AS LAST_PROD_STATUS
FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PG ON WO.ORDER_ID = PG.ORDER_ID

ORDER BY WO.ORDER_DATE DESC, WO.ORDER_ID DESC ) PROGRESS_LIST WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE RN >= #{startRow}

SELECT WO.ORDER_ID, WO.PROD_PLAN_ID, WO.LINE_ID, WO.EMP_ID, WO.PRODUCT_LOT, WO.ORDER_QTY, TO_CHAR(WO.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE, WO.DOC_NO AS WORK_ORDER_DOC_NO,
PP.DOC_NO AS PROD_PLAN_DOC_NO, PP.PROD_PLAN_QTY, TO_CHAR(PP.PROD_PLAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_PLAN_DATE, TO_CHAR(PP.DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DUE_DATE,
I.ITEM_ID, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_UNIT,
L.LINE_CODE, L.LINE_NAME, L.LINE_STATUS,
E.EMPNO, E.ENAME, E.DEPT, E.JOB, E.ROLE,
P.PROD_ID, TO_CHAR(P.PROD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_DATE, NVL(P.PROD_QTY, 0) AS PROD_QTY, NVL(P.LOSS_QTY, 0) AS LOSS_QTY, NVL(P.PROD_STATUS, '대기') AS PROD_STATUS, NVL(P.INSPECTION_STATUS, '검사 예정') AS INSPECTION_STATUS,
NVL(PG.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) AS TOTAL_PROD_QTY, NVL(PG.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY,
CASE WHEN NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE LEAST( 100, ROUND( ( NVL(PG.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) + NVL(PG.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0) ) / WO.ORDER_QTY * 100 ) ) END AS PROGRESS_RATE,
AS PROGRESS_STATUS
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON WO.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.* FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) P ON WO.ORDER_ID = P.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID,
SUM( CASE WHEN NVL(PROD_STATUS, '완료') != '취소' THEN NVL(PROD_QTY, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS TOTAL_PROD_QTY,
SUM( CASE WHEN NVL(PROD_STATUS, '완료') != '취소' THEN NVL(LOSS_QTY, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY,
MAX(PROD_STATUS) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY PROD_ID) AS LAST_PROD_STATUS
FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PG ON WO.ORDER_ID = PG.ORDER_ID
WHERE WO.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BD.BOM_DETAIL_ID ASC, MI.INOUT_ID ASC ) AS ROW_NO,
WO.ORDER_ID, WO.ORDER_QTY,
B.BOM_ID, B.BOM_CODE, B.VERSION AS BOM_VERSION, B.USE_YN AS BOM_USE_YN,
BD.BOM_DETAIL_ID, BD.QTY AS BOM_QTY, CASE WHEN I.ITEM_UNIT IN ('EA', '개', 'BOX') THEN CEIL(NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0)) ELSE NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) * NVL(BD.QTY, 0) END AS REQUIRED_QTY,
I.ITEM_ID AS MATERIAL_ITEM_ID, I.ITEM_CODE AS MATERIAL_ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME AS MATERIAL_ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_TYPE AS MATERIAL_ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_UNIT AS MATERIAL_ITEM_UNIT,
MI.INOUT_ID, MI.INOUT_TYPE, MI.MATERIAL_LOT, MI.INOUT_QTY, TO_CHAR(MI.INOUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INOUT_DATE, MI.STATUS AS INOUT_STATUS, MI.USE_YN, MI.REMARK AS INOUT_REMARK
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN BOM B ON B.ITEM_ID = PP.ITEM_ID AND NVL(B.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
JOIN BOM_DETAIL BD ON B.BOM_ID = BD.BOM_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON BD.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN MATERIAL_INOUT MI ON MI.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND MI.ITEM_ID = BD.ITEM_ID AND MI.INOUT_TYPE = 'MO-PROD' AND NVL(MI.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
WHERE WO.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
ORDER BY BD.BOM_DETAIL_ID ASC, MI.INOUT_ID ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY E.EQUIP_ID ASC ) AS ROW_NO,
WO.ORDER_ID, WO.LINE_ID,
L.LINE_CODE, L.LINE_NAME, L.LINE_STATUS,
E.EQUIP_ID, E.EQUIP_CODE, E.EQUIP_NAME, E.EQUIP_STATUS, E.EQUIP_LOC
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN EQUIPMENT E ON E.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID AND NVL(E.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
WHERE WO.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
ORDER BY E.EQUIP_ID ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WORK_ORDER WHERE PROD_PLAN_ID = #{prodPlanId}
